capability_findings.observed: APB3-class signal set only: the port declaration contains exactly the APB3 subset and no PSTRB, PPROT, PWAKEUP, PUSER/PWUSER/PRUSER or PZERO. Elaboration accepts the module with only these ports.

No write-strobe input exists. The write case arms whole 32-bit registers and the write-enable masks are literal 32'hFFFFFFFF (e.g. REG_PADDIR_00_31, REG_PADOUT_32_63), so a write always updates all bits of the selected register; a partial/byte write can only be emulated as a full-word write.
Hardwired constant: `assign PREADY = 1'b1;` - the slave completes every access in the APB access phase and can never insert a wait state.
Hardwired constant: `assign PSLVERR = 1'b0;` - the IP never signals an APB error, and no RTL path can set it.

Reads of register indices that have no case item fall into `default: PRDATA = 'h0;`. Writes to such indices set s_write=1 but select no write-enable mask, so no state changes. Neither case raises PSLVERR; accesses are silently ignored / read as zero.

Only PADDR[6:2] is decoded into the 5-bit index s_apb_addr; APB_ADDR_WIDTH only widens the port and every upper address bit is ignored, so the 4 KB APB window aliases every 128 bytes. There is no out-of-range detection or alias rejection.

gpio_in goes through a 3-stage chain (r_gpio_sync0 -> r_gpio_sync1 -> r_gpio_in), but each stage only advances when the pad's GPIOEN group clock-enable s_clk_en[j/4] is high (s_clk_en ORs the r_gpio_en bits of four consecutive pads). If all four pads of a group have GPIOEN=0, their sampled value, PADIN read and edge detectors never change even while the pad inputs toggle.

`interrupt` is a one-cycle combinational pulse, not a held level: it equals |(r_gpio_inten & r_gpio_en & edge) computed from r_gpio_sync1 vs r_gpio_in. Latching is separate, in r_status, and is cleared only by reading REG_INTSTATUS_00_31 (0x24) or REG_INTSTATUS_32_63 (0x28).
2'b00 = falling edge, 2'b01 = rising edge, 2'b10 = rising-or-falling (the inline comment says 'rise' but the RTL ORs rise|fall), 2'b11 = no event because all three s_is_int_* terms are 0.

Declared as an input but the identifier occurs exactly once in the file (the port declaration) - it is never referenced by logic, so it has no effect on behaviour and no clock gating is implemented in this RTL.
All state is on posedge HCLK with asynchronous active-low reset (negedge HRESETn); single clock domain, no CDC.

The pinned filelist (Bender.yml/src_files.yml) is a single source; Verilator elaborates apb_gpio from that one file with parameters APB_ADDR_WIDTH=12/PAD_NUM=32/NBIT_PADCFG=4, exit 0 with 2 warnings (CASEINCOMPLETE at 276, SYMRSVDWORD at 65). Removing the file fails; running in a tree containing only this file reproduces exit 0.

unsupported.reason: No PSTRB input and no per-byte write enables; all register writes are full 32-bit words, so byte/partial writes cannot be expressed or verified.
No PPROT/PWAKEUP/PUSER/PWUSER/PRUSER/PZERO ports exist; security/privilege and user-sideband semantics are unavailable.
PSLVERR is tied to 1'b0 while unmapped reads return 0 and unmapped writes are dropped, so error signalling cannot be driven or observed.
PREADY is tied to 1'b1; the slave cannot stall an access, so PREADY-dependent adapter behaviour cannot be exercised against this IP.
dft_cg_enable_i is unused, so there is no controllable clock-gating behaviour to model or drive.
Only PADDR[6:2] is decoded; a full 4 KB APB window aliases every 128 bytes with no error or alias indication.
The interrupt output is a one-cycle pulse, not a level held until acknowledge; a level-sensitive aggregator must instead poll the latched INTSTATUS registers.
